1.title: Hair Flip
1.text: Shantae finishes her routine on stage and hops lightly down into the empty hall, her long purple ponytail still swishing against her hips. "Whew! Did you see that final spin? Nearly took out a lantern." Damp with sweat and glowing in the low lamplight, she grins up at you with jingling brass armbands. "You always stay till the very end—nobody else does that. You must really like watching me move."

image.comp: grinning with a wild ponytail and flushed cheeks, one hand on his arm, cheerful spark
image.setting: empty stage hall after a show with lanterns burning low

1.goRes: She giggles brightly against your lips before parting them to kiss you back, whooping softly and spinning into a dizzy pirouette afterward. "Best encore ever!"
1.waitRes: "Aw, no fair!" She pokes your chest, bouncing on her bare toes. "Okay—though I'm definitely going to keep dancing in your direction."

2.title: Magic Lamp
2.text: Shantae pulls a dented brass lamp from her bag and sets it on the bar counter, leaning close enough that you can smell honeysuckle and warm skin. "My genie side wants to grant you one wish—anything you want, free of charge!" Seeing your eyes linger on her bare midriff and hips, her ponytail swishes with sudden, shy heat. "...Oh. You're wishing for me, aren't you?"

image.comp: sitting on a bar stool with a small lamp, smiling shyly, ponytail drooping
image.setting: bar counter with a dented magic lamp and glimmering bottles

2.goRes: Faint magic glitter swirls around you both behind the bar as her clever hands and warm mouth grant your wish—starting with breathless giggles and ending in a low, shivering moan.
2.waitRes: "Okay!" She hops down from the stool, cheerful and flushed. "I'll hold onto that wish until you're ready—genies are very patient."

3.title: Dancing Till Dawn
3.text: Shantae dances until the last lantern gutters out and the town falls silent—and you're still watching from the edge of the stage. Stopping breathless with damp hair clinging to her neck, she unfastens her silk vest and lets it slip to the floorboards. "I save Scuttle Town for fun, Sam, yet this has my knees shaking. Dance with me in bed?"

image.comp: extending a hand with a breathless smile, ponytail loose, flushed cheeks
image.setting: empty stage hall at dawn, a single lantern left, golden light through a high window

3.goRes: You carry her up the stairs to your room, peeling off her harem silks and sinking deep into her heat—Shantae arching beneath you with breathless, joyful cries until sunrise.
3.waitRes: "Okay!" She bounces on her bare toes, grinning brightly. "I'll practice—tomorrow, with extra hip-sway."

jump.title: Impulse Spin
jump.text: Shantae is mid-twirl in the dim hallway when she crashes straight into your chest, her long purple hair whipping around you both. Tangled together with noses nearly touching, her giggles soften into a flush as she presses her bare midriff against your hands. "Oops—actually, that wasn't an accident. I was aiming right for you."

image.comp: crashing into his chest mid-spin, giggling, hair whipping around them
image.setting: upstairs hallway with a flickering lantern

jump.goRes: She melts into your mouth with a breathless laugh, grabbing your belt and tugging you straight through your bedroom door.
jump.waitRes: "Ooh, mixed signals!" She grins and boops your nose. "I'll just have to keep aiming at you until I hit."

1.title: Plunder
1.text: Risky has been tallying the house coin for an hour with a sharp, hungry gleam in her eyes. When you bring her wine, she slips a small leather pouch of sovereigns into her coat without blinking. "Don't glare at me like that—it's part of the plan. Admit it: you know I'm plotting to rob this place blind, yet you still bring me drinks."

image.comp: leaning back in a chair with a small coin bag and a sly smile, tricorn hat on the table
image.setting: office with a ledger and a candlelit desk, a wine bottle

1.goRes: She laughs in pure delight, grabs your collar, and kisses you fiercely for the sheer nerve of it. "Pirate's code: never plunder a man who steals right back."
1.waitRes: "Tch—you drive a hard bargain." She tips her tricorn hat with a wicked wink. "I'll steal that kiss soon enough."

2.title: Treasure Map
2.text: Risky unrolls a tea-stained treasure map across your study desk, leaning forward so her cleavage spills over the parchment as she drags a ringed fingernail down the ink—stopping squarely over your belt. "I rigged the chart, of course. X marks the real prize right here... shall we start digging?"

image.comp: leaning over the desk with a sly smile, one finger resting on his chest
image.setting: Sam's study with a spread-out map, brandy and candles

2.goRes: She shoves the map onto the floorboards, unbuckles your trousers with ruthless efficiency, and works you with her hands and mouth until you're gripping the desk edge.
2.waitRes: "Hmph." She smirks, rolling up the parchment. "The treasure will keep—and so will I."

3.title: Ship's Quarters
3.text: Risky invites you into her bedroom, decked out with rigged ropes and billowed sailcloth like a captain's cabin. Pouring two glasses of dark rum, she sits on the edge of the bed with her coat discarded and her silk chemise unlaced low. "I lost my galleon, Sam, not my appetite—care to let me plunder you all night?"

image.comp: sitting on a bed with legs crossed and a rum glass, mischievous smile
image.setting: her room decked out like a ship's cabin with sails and rope and lantern light

3.goRes: You surrender gladly as she straddles your hips and rides you like a conquering pirate—until her fierce bravado breaks into breathless, clinging moans.
3.waitRes: "Pity." She raises her rum glass in a sly toast. "Still, any good captain knows how to wait for high tide."

jump.title: Cutthroat
jump.text: Risky pins you back against the pantry door with one hand braced beside your head and her knee wedged firmly between your thighs. "I'll ruin you, Sam—outbid you, outwit you, and outlast you," she purrs, spiced perfume enveloping you as her other hand drops to your belt. "Starting right now."

image.comp: pinning him against a door with a hand beside his head, wicked grin
image.setting: pantry door in a dim hallway, a lantern behind her

jump.goRes: You kiss her hungrily, hiking up her skirt right against the pantry door and thrusting into her while she gasps furiously at how good it feels.
jump.waitRes: "Hmph." She steps back, smoothing her coat with a smirk. "You're lucky I enjoy a challenge."

1.title: Dead Tired
1.text: Rottytops slumps across the bar counter at dawn with her green hair a wild tangle, grinning from ear to ear. "Dead tired—get it? Because I'm a zombie!" When you actually laugh, she flushes bright pink beneath her stitches. "Nobody ever laughs at my terrible jokes except you."

image.comp: slumped over the bar with a wide, tired grin, green hair messy, flushed cheeks
image.setting: bar at dawn with pale light and empty mugs

1.goRes: She tastes like sweet berries and cool morning air, letting out a startled gasp before giggling happily against your shoulder. "Eep! I feel totally alive right now!"
1.waitRes: "Aw, bummer." She pats your cheek, bouncing right back up. "Okay! Later—I'm awesome at later."

2.title: Night Shift
2.text: Rottytops sits on the edge of the roof under a canopy of stars, swinging her stitched legs over the eaves. "Zombies barely sleep, so I get hours and hours to daydream," she says brightly, sliding over to press her thigh against yours and rest a cool hand on your lap. "Mostly about getting my hands on you. Is that weird? Don't answer."

image.comp: sitting on a roof with her legs swinging, bright smile with a shy blush
image.setting: rooftop at night under stars, her legs dangling over the edge

2.goRes: Out on the starlit tiles, she leans in cheerful, shameless, and endlessly curious—exploring you with eager hands and mouth until you're breathless.
2.waitRes: "Okay!" She hops up with a slight wobble. "Totally fine—I just wanted to say it out loud."

3.title: Graveyard Shift
3.text: Rottytops pops her head out from beneath your bedframe at midnight, cobwebs tangled in her green hair and a hopeful grin on her face. "Surprise! Couldn't wait till morning—can I stay in bed with you? I don't need sleep, and my cuddling game is a solid ten out of ten."

image.comp: peering over the edge of a bed with cobwebs in her hair, wide hopeful smile
image.setting: Sam's room, moonlit, a scattering of mismatched socks

3.goRes: She climbs onto the mattress, sheds her tattered clothes, and straddles your lap—giggling and moaning breathlessly as the night turns wild fast.
3.waitRes: "Okay, okay!" She ducks back under the bedframe. "I'll just hang out down here—super quietly. Probably."

jump.title: Surprise Kiss
jump.text: Rottytops leaps out from behind a doorway shouting "Boo!"—and when you don't even flinch, she tilts her head with a wide, wicked grin. "Huh, not scared at all? Let's try this instead!" Grabbing your face in both hands, she plants a loud, messy kiss right on your mouth.

image.comp: grabbing his face mid-leap, grinning wildly
image.setting: hallway doorway with a lantern and shadows

jump.goRes: She squeals in delight, wraps her legs around your waist, and lets you carry her straight to your bedroom.
jump.waitRes: "Oops!" She laughs, ears turning pink. "Too fast—I'll try slower next time. Maybe."
